questions.question: One can never imagine / how hot it gets in Delhi / unless one doesn't go / there in person.
options: how hot it gets in Delhi
questions.solution: use 'goes' instead of 'doesn't go'. Explanation:- 'unless' ka matlab 'agar nahi', 'until' ka matlab 'jab tak nahi', 'Unless/until' mein 'not' already hota hai, isliye jis clause mein 'unless' yaa 'until' ka use hota hai usme 'not' ka use nahi karte. isliye yahan 'doesn't go' ki jagah 'goes' aayega

questions.question: Both the rich along with the poor /are responsible for a great many /vices with which our society as well as country is inflicted.
options: Both the rich along with the poor
are responsible for a great many
vices with which our society as well as country is inflicted.
questions.solution: Use 'and' in place of 'along with'. Explanation:- 'along' ki jagah 'and' aayega kyunki 'both' ke sath 'and' ka pair hota hai jab do cheezon ko connect karna hota hai, isliye yahan 'both the rich and the poor' sahi hoga.

questions.question: He knows that / he has no other option / but to work hard.
questions.solution: use 'than' instead of 'but'. Explanation:- 'but' ki jagah 'than' aayega kyunki 'other' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: As soon as he /opened the old wooden box /then a rat jumped out of it.
options: then a rat jumped out of it.
questions.solution: Remove 'then'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'then' ka use nahi hoga kyunki 2 clauses ko join karne ke liye 'as soon as' conjunction ka use kiya hai. 'as soon as' ka matlab 'jaise hi' hota hai aur 'then' ka matlab 'tab' hota hai, sentence ka maltab hai 'jaise hee usne box khola, ek rat jump maarke bahaar aa gaya', toh meaning aur grammar wise 'then' adverb ka use galat hai.

questions.question: We stayed / in Jim's flat / during he was / on holiday.
questions.solution: use 'while' instead of 'during'. Explanation:- 'during' ek preposition hai aur yahan 2 clauses ko join karne ke liye conjunction ki zarurat hai, sentence ka matlab chahiye 'hum Jim ke flat pe ruke the jab wo holiday pe gaya tha', toh duration refer karne ke liye 'while' conjunction ka use krenge. Note:- 'While' ke baad bhale hi 'continuous tense' nahi likha hai lekin 'while he was on a holiday' duration ko hi refer kar raha hai.

questions.question: He asked me that why /I was not preparing for the /Civil Service Examinations.
options: I was not preparing for the
questions.solution: Remove 'that'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'that' ka use nahi hoga kyunki yeh interrogative sentence hai jo indirect speech mein likha hai, matlab question pucha jaa raha hai. Toh indirect speech mein 'how, why, where, when' yeh word khud conjunction ki tarah kaam kar dete hai, isliye 'asked' verb ke clause jodne ke liye 'how, why, where, when' ka use hoga aur 'that' ka use galat hota hai.

questions.question: No sooner did / the child start crying / then the mother / hugged him.
questions.solution: replace 'then' with 'than'. Explanation:- 'no sooner' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai jo ek correlative conjunction hoti hai.

questions.question: She is as intelligent, if not /more intelligent than one /of the students of that institute.
options: She is as intelligent, if not
of the students of that institute.
questions.solution: Use 'as intelligent as' in place of 'as intelligent'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'as intelligent as' ka use hoga kyunki 'simile' ka pura structure likha jaayega. Iss sentence ka real structure yeh hai 'She is as intelligent as one of the students of that institute is, if she is not more intelligent than one of the students of that institute is' Yahan same 2 cheezon ka 2 baar comparison hua hai, isliye 'subject + verb' understood ho gaye hain. lekin simile toh poori likhni padegi, isliye yahan 'as intelligent as' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Alex picked up the boxes quite easily even they were heavy.
questions.solution: use 'though' instead of 'even'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'even' ki jagah 'though' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab chahiye 'Alex ne boxes aasaani se uttha liya haalanki wo heavy the', toh sentence mein contradiction show karna ke liye conjunction ki jarurat hai, jabki 'even' adverb hota hai, isliye yahan 'even' ki jagah 'though' contradiction waali conjunction ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: The college library is /not only equipped with very good /books but also with the latest journals.
options: not only equipped with very good
books but also with the latest journals.
questions.solution: Use 'equipped not only' in place of 'not only equipped'. Explanation:- kyunki 'not only-but also' ek aise co-relative conjunction ka pair hai jo same rank ke words ko join karta hai. 'but also' ke sath 'with' preposition hai 'verb' nahi hai, jabki 'not only' ke sath 'verb' likhi hai, toh yahan 'not only' ko 'with' preposition ke sath likh denge, jisse dono word preposition ke sath sahi honge, isliye yahan 'equipped not only with' sahi hoga.

questions.question: They had hardly completed / half of the work / than the boss called them.
questions.solution: use 'when' instead of 'than'. Explanation:- 'hardly/scarcely' ke sath 'when' ka pair hota hai joki ek co-relative conjunction hoti hai

questions.question: A mother said to her children /"Walk carefully, lest you /may fall down or hurt yourself".
options: A mother said to her children.
may fall down or hurt yourself".
questions.solution: Use 'should' in place of 'may'. Explanation:- 'lest' ke sath 'should' ka pair hota hai joki ek co-relative conjunction hai

questions.question: No sooner did Priya / get her report card / when she started jumping/ with joy.
questions.solution: use 'than' instead of 'when'. Explanation:- 'no sooner' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai joki ek co-relative conjunction hoti hai.

questions.question: I work hard and study well /that I may pass in the /examination and make my parents proud.
options: I work hard and study well
that I may pass in the
examination and make my parents proud.
questions.solution: Use 'so that' in place of 'that'. Explanation:- 'so that' ka matlab 'taaki' hota hai, yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'maine bahut mehnat se kaam kiya aur acche se padhai kari taaki mein exam pass kar saku or mere parents ko proud feel kara saku', toh sahi meaning ke according 'so that' conjunction sahi hogi. 'that' conjunction ka matlab 'ki' hota hai.

questions.question: It is misleading / to imagine that / computers can think /same like human beings.
questions.solution: use 'the same as' instead of 'same like'. Explanation:- 'like' ki jagah 'as' aayega kyunki 'like' ka maltab 'kisi cheez yaa vyakti ke jaise', lekin 'computer' aur 'human being' ek jaise nahi ho sakte, 'as' ka use 'logon yaa cheezon ka compare' karne ke liye use hota hai, joki sentence mein karna hai, aur waise bhi 'the same as' ek phrase hota hai jiska matlab 'do cheezein ek jaise yaa bilkul same tarike se ho', isliye yahan meaning ke according 'the same as' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Supposing if a number of ghosts /meet us in the forest, will we be /able to get rid of them easily without that magical wand ?
options: Supposing if a number of ghosts
meet us in the forest, will we be
able to get rid of them easily without that magical wand ?
questions.solution: Use either 'Supposing' or 'if' in place of Supposing if. Explanation:- kyunki 'supposing' aur 'if' dono ka same meaning hota hai aur dono conjunction hoti hain aur hume yahan ek hi conjunction chahiye, isliye dono mein se koi ek use karenge. Dono ka use sath mein superfluous ki category mein aata hai

questions.question: Until I was / still a little weak, / I decided to walk home / from the metro station.
questions.solution: Use 'Although' in place of 'Until'. Explanation:- sentence ka meaning yeh dena hai ki 'halaanki main abhi bhi thoda kamzor tha, maine metro station se ghar paidal gaya', toh sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai ki kamjor hone ke baad bhi paidal gaya, isliye yahan 'halaanki' waale meaning ke liye 'until' nahi 'although' conjunction ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Since Dipawali is around the /corner, Manjeet and Preeti have /brought some fire crackers as lauki, rockets, etc.
options: brought some fire crackers as lauki, rockets, etc.
questions.solution: Use 'like' or 'such as' in place of 'as.' Explanation:- kyunki 'like' aur 'such as' preposition ki tarah kaam karte hain aur 'as' ek conjunction ki tarah. Yahan hume preposition ki requirement hai. Sentence ka maltab hai 'Preeti fatake leke aayi jaise ki lauki, rocket etc', toh 'jaise ki' waale meaning ke liye 'like' yaa 'such as' preposition ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: If you rent a house near your office, it will save you time as well as also money.
questions.solution: Remove 'also'. Explanation:- kyunki 'as well as' ek preposition phrase hai jo 2 nouns ko connect karta hai iska meaning 'aur' hota hai isliye iske sath 'also' lagana superfluous ho jaayega. Note:- 'it will save you time' mein koi galti nahi hai. yahan 'save' di-transitive verb hai. 'You' indirect object hai aur 'time' direct object agar 'it will save your time' likha hota toh wo bhi sahi hota.

questions.question: You are still a very weak /friend of mine, so you must /take fruit as apples, orange, mangoes bananas, etc.
options: You are still a very weak
friend of mine, so you must
take fruit as apples, orange, mangoes bananas, etc.
questions.solution: Use 'such as / like' in place of 'as'. Explanation:- kyunki 'like' aur 'such as' preposition ki tarah kaam karte hain aur 'as' ek conjunction ki tarah. Yahan hume preposition ki requirement hai. Sentence ka matlab hai 'tumhe fruits lene chahiye jaise ki apple, orange, mango etc', toh 'jaise ki' waale meaning ke liye 'like' yaa 'such as' preposition ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Notwithstanding we were / all busy that weekend / we had to /cancel the outing.
questions.solution: use 'Since or as' instead of 'notwithstanding'. Explanation:- 'notwithstanding' ek adverb hoti hai jiska matlab hota hai 'fir bhi', lekin hume 'we were' aur 'we had' do clause ko jodne ke liye yahan ek conjunction ki jarurat hai, sentence ka matlab chahiye 'kyunki hum busy the uss weekend hume outing cancel karni padi', toh 'kyunki' waale meaning ke liye 'since' yaa 'as' conjunction ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Many of the founding fathers /of our constitution are so /revered as Ambedkar if not more.
options: revered as Ambedkar if not more.
questions.solution: Use 'as' in place of 'so'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'simile' ki jarurat hai. yahan meaning yeh dena hai 'constitution ke founding fathers mein se bahut saare Ambedkar ke jitne hi respected hain agar unse zyada nahi toh'. toh 'so….as' ka use negative comparison ke liye hota hai aur 'as….as' dono positive aur negative dono ke liye, sentence mein positive comparison karna hai, isliye 'as revered as' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The farmers are using HYV seeds so then they can get a better yield.
questions.solution: use 'so that' instead of 'so then'. Explanation:- 'so that' ka matlab 'taaki' hota hai, Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'kisaan HYV seeds ka use karte hain taaki unki paida waar zyada ho sake'. Toh meaning ke according 'so that' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: If he is very good at /mathematics, his brother is /absolutely hopeless.
options: If he is very good at
questions.solution: Use 'While' in place of 'If'. Explanation:- sentence mein dono bhaiyon ke difference ko dikhana hai aur sentence ka matlab hai 'wo maths mein bahut accha hai jabki uska bhai bilkul hopeless hai', toh yahan 'jabki' waala meaning dena hai naa ki 'agar' waala. Toh 'jabki' waale meaning ke liye 'while' conjunction ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: As soon he heard / the sound of thunder, / he hid / under the bed.
questions.solution: use 'as soon as' instead of 'as soon'. Explanation:- sentence ka matlab hai 'jaise he usne thunder ki awaz suni, wo bed ke neche chuph gaya', toh 'jaise hi' waale meaning ke liye 'as soon as' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Such individuals who /take up this role often /find life frustrating.
questions.solution: Use 'as' in place of 'who'. Explanation:- sentence ka matlab hai 'aise individual jo yeh role nibhaate hai aksar unhe jeevan mein niraasha ka saamna karna padta hai. Toh 'such….as' ka pair 'jo, jaisa, jisne' waale meaning ke taur pe use hota hai. Sentence mein 'jo' waala meaning chahiye, isliyan 'such individual as' sahi hoga.

questions.question: He is / too immature / for handle / the situation.
questions.solution: use 'to handle' instead of 'for handle'. Explanation:- sentence ka matlab hai 'wo abhi bahut immature hai iss situation ko handle karne ke liye', toh sentence mein negative meaning convey karna jiske liye 'too…….to + v1' ka structure use hota hai, isliye yahan 'too' ke sath 'to handle' infinitive ka use hoga.

questions.question: By the end of the day we /were tired and happy because /our efforts did not go in vain.
options: By the end of the day we
our efforts did not go in vain.
questions.solution: Use 'but' in place of 'and'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'tired' aur 'happy' contradictory adjective hain, toh contradiction dikhaane ke liye 'and' nahi 'but' conjunction ka use hoga. Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'hum thake hue the lekin khush the kyunki.....', toh meaning ke according 'but' sahi hoga.

questions.question: You cannot lead a healthy life although you stop smoking.
questions.solution: use 'unless/until' instead of 'although'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'although' ki jagah 'unless/until' aayega kyunki yahan 'agar nahi/jab tak nahi' waala meaning convey karna hai. Sentence ka meaning yeh dena hai 'tum ek healthy life nahi jee sakte agar/jabtak tum smoking band nahi karoge'. Toh meaning ke according 'unless/until' dono ka use sahi hai.

questions.question: Smartphone cameras can now take pictures of near-professional quality, so they also have limitations.
questions.solution: use 'but' instead of 'so'. Explanation:- sentence ke meaning ke according contradiction show karna hai, yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'Smartphone ke camera professional quality picture le sakte hai, lekin unki limitation hoti hai', toh meaning ke according 'but' conjunction sahi hogi.

questions.question: The construction of multi-storey /buildings near the airport is going /on yet the airport authority has objected to it.
options: buildings near the airport is going
on yet the airport authority has objected to it.
questions.solution: Use 'though/ although' in place of 'yet'. Explanation:- 'although/though' ka maltab 'haalanki' hota hai, 'Yet' conjunction ka matlab 'phir bhi, iske babjood', Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'construction chal rha hai haalanki airport authority objection kar chuki hai', toh opposite reason bataane ke liye 'though/altough' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Miss Marple is neither a good singer or the good stage artist.
questions.solution: use 'nor' instead of 'or'. Explanation:- 'neither' ke sath 'nor' ka pair hota hai joki ek co-relative conjunction hai. Aur yeh same rank ke words ko connect karte hai.

questions.question: Immediately after boarding /the bus, Mukesh asked the conductor /that he knew where the museum was.
options: the bus Mukesh asked the conductor
that he knew where the museum was.
questions.solution: Use 'if' in place of 'that'. Explanation:- 'if' ka matlab 'kya' aur 'that' jab conjuction hoti hai toh iska matlab 'ki' hota hai. Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'Mukesh ne conductor se puchha tha kya usse pata hai museum kahan hai', toh meaning ke according 'kya' waala meaning sahi hoga, isliye yahan 'if' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: She will come to work though it doesn't rain tomorrow.
questions.solution: use 'if' instead of 'though'. Explanation:- 'if' ka matlab 'agar' hota hai aur 'though' ka matlab 'haalaki'. Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'wo kaam par aayegi agar kal barsaat nahi hogi.' Toh sentence ke according 'agar' waale meaning ke liye 'if' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Not only children have fewer chances of surviving and are underfed, but they also lack educational opportunities.
options: Not only does the child has
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'not only' se sentence shuru hua hai isliye inversion lagega. Aur inversion mein verb subject se pehle aati hai, jiska structure 'not only + H.V. + subject + M.V.' hota hai, sentence mein 'are underfed' se pata chal raha ki prenset tense ki baat ho rahi hai, aur 'children' plural subject hai isliye verb plural aayegi, isliye yahan 'not only do children have' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The reason for visiting Meerut was because my mother needed to be looked after.
questions.solution: Use 'that' in place of 'because'. Explanation:- 'the reason' aur 'because' dono 'kaaran' batane ke liye use hote hai, agar sentence mein 'the reason' laga diya hai toh 'because' nahi aayega. Sentence ka matlab dena hai 'Meerut jaane ka yeh kaaran tha ki usse apni mother ki dekhbhaal karni thi', toh 'ki' waale meaning ke according 'that' conjunction ka use hoga.

questions.question: When he fell down the ditch, he shouted with all his might so that to catch someone's attention.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'so that' aur 'so as' dono hi structure ka use 'taaki' waale meaning ke liye hota hai yaa hum keh sakte hain ki kisi action ka reason batane ke liye kiya jaata hai, lekin 'so that' ke baad 'clause' banta hai, jabki 'so as' ke sath 'to + V1(Infinitive)' ka use hota hai, option C mein 'so that' ke baad clause nahi ban raha aur sentence mein 'taaki' wala meaning bhi chahiye, isliye yahan 'so as to catch' wala option B sahi hoga. 'such that' ka matlab 'aisa hai ki' aur 'so then' ka matlab 'toh phir'

questions.question: I shall buy this book if you like it or not.
questions.solution: use 'whether' instead of 'if'. Explanation:- 'whether' ke sath 'or' ka pair hota hai jo co-relative conjunction hoti hai.

questions.question: He gave such a long speech but everybody felt bored.
questions.solution: use 'that' instead of 'but'. Explanation:- 'such –as' ka use (jo, jisne, jisko) waale meaning ke liye hota hai aur 'such – that' ka use 'ki' waale meaning ke liye hota hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'usne itni lambi speech di ki sab bore ho gaye', toh 'ki' waale meaning ke liye 'such' ke sath 'that' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: She lost a big order from a known showroom in case of her own carelessness.
questions.solution: use 'because of' instead of 'in case of'. Explanation:- 'beacuse of' ka matlab 'iss cheez ki wajah se' aur 'in case of' ka matlab 'iss situation mein'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'usne bada order khoyaa apni carelessness ki wazah se', isliye yahan 'because of' ka use sahi hoga. Note:- 'because' conjunction hoti hai, aur 'because of' preposition. Sentence mein koi clause jodna isliye yahan meaning aur grammar wise 'because of' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Zoya won the first prize in the race unless she stumbled and fell.
questions.solution: use 'although' instead of 'unless'. Explanation:- 'unless' ki jagah 'although' aayega kyunki 'unless' se meaning 'Zoya first prize jeet gayi thi agar wo giri nahi hoti', lekin meaning mein samajh aa raha hai wo race jeet gayi thi, toh sahi matlab hona chahiye 'Zoya race mein first prize jeeti thi haalanki wo ladkhadai aur giri thi', matlab wo girne ke baad bhi first prize jeet gayi, isliye yahan contradiction dikhaane ke liye 'although' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Aren't you such young to travel by yourself?
questions.solution: use 'too young' or 'young enough' instead of 'such young'. Explanation:- 'to +v1' infinitve ke sath 'too' yaa 'enough' ka pair hota hai. 'too young to travel' se negative meaning aayega 'kya tum jyada chote nahi ho akele travel karne ke liye', aur 'young enough to travel' se positive meaning aayega 'kya tum akele travel karne ke liye kaafi chote nahi ho?', meaning ke according 'too young', 'young enough' dono sahi honge.

questions.question: As such you need any money, just write to me.
questions.solution: use 'if' instead of 'as such'. Explanation:- 'if' ka matlab 'agar' hota hai 'as such' ka matlab 'Sahi maayne mein'. Sentence ka matlab chahiye 'agar tumhe paison ki jarurat ho, toh mujhe likh dena', toh sahi meaning ke according 'if' ka use sahi hoga. Some examples to understand the meaning 'as such'. 1. There wasn't much vegetarian food as such, although there were several different types of cheese. 2. We don't have a secretary as such, but we have a student who helps us.

questions.question: It's raining heavily, so you should take an umbrella, but you will get wet.
questions.solution: use 'otherwise' instead of 'but'. Explanation:- 'otherwise' ka matlab 'warna' hota hai, aur 'but' ka matlab 'lekin'. Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki '.....warna tum bheeg jaoge'. Toh sahi meaning ke according 'otherwise' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I was surprised to see as Avika could write such good poems in Hindi.
questions.solution: use 'that' instead of 'as'. Explanation:- 'that' ka matlab 'ki' hota hai jab yeh conjunction hoti hai aur 'as' ka matlab 'kyunki', Yahan meaning yeh hai ki 'mai yeh dekh kar hairaan tha ki Avika hindi mein itni acchi poem likhti hai', toh 'ki' waale meaning ke liye 'that' conjunction ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Unless you prepare well, you will not get a first class.
questions.solution: No error 'unless' ka maltab 'agar nahi'

questions.question: It is easier to preach then to follow.
questions.solution: use 'than' instead of 'then'. Explanation:- kyunki comparative degree ke sath 'than' ka use kiya jaata hai, 'then' time ko batane ke liye use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Do not let the opportunity slip away and you will repent.
questions.solution: use 'otherwise' instead of 'and'. Explanation:- 'otherwise' ka maltab 'warna', aur 'and' ka matlab 'aur' hota hai Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'iss opportunity ko jaane mat do warna tum pachtaoge.', toh sahi meaning ke according 'otherwise' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If they said nothing, she could sense their disapproval of her suggestion.
questions.solution: use 'although' instead of 'if'. Explanation:- 'if' ka matlab 'agar', aur 'although' ka matlab 'haalaki' hota hai. Yahan sentence ka meaning yeh hai ki 'haalanki unhone kuch nahi kaha, wo bhaanp sakti thi unka disapproval', toh sahi meaning ke liye 'although' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Put off the air conditioner unless you will catch a cold.
questions.solution: use 'otherwise' instead of 'unless'. Explanation:- 'unless' ka matlab 'agar nahi', aur 'otherwise' ka matlab 'warna' hota hai Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki '....warna tumhe thand lag jayegi.', toh sahi meaning ke liye 'otherwise' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Sushmita's youngest sister is not only beautiful but even intelligent also.
questions.solution: use 'but also intelligent' instead of 'but even intelligent also'. Explanation:- sentence ka matlab hai 'Sushmita ki choti sister sirf sundar he nahi balki intelligent bhi hai', toh 'not only' ke sath 'but also' ka pair hota hai joki co-relative conjunction hai aur same rank ke words ko connect karti hai, agar 'not only' ke baad 'beautiful' adjective hai, toh 'but also' ke baad bhi 'intelligent' adjective aayega, isliye yahan 'but also intelligent' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Preeti is absent from the meeting due to she is out of station.
questions.solution: use 'because' instead of 'due to'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'due to' ki jagah 'because' aayega, kyunki yahan 'Preeti is' aur 'she is' do clause ko jodne ke liye conjunction ki jarurat hai aur 'reason' ko batane waali conjunction ki need hai, 'because' ek conjunction hoti hai, jabki 'due to' ek prepositional phrase hota hai, isliye yahan 'because' conjunction ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: The soldiers had no choice when to obey the commander.
questions.solution: use 'but' instead of 'when'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'when' ki jagah 'but' aayega kyunki sentence mein ek hee clause hai, toh conjunction ki jarurat nahi hai, aur 'when' conjunction ka kaam kar raha hai. Sentence ka matlab hai 'soldier ke pass commander ki baat manane ke sivaay koi aur option nahi tha', toh 'no choice but to' phrase hota hai jiska matlab 'ek hee option hona, aur koi choice naa hona' hota hai, jisme 'but' preposition ka kaam kar raha hai aur iska matlab 'ke sivaay' hota hai, isliye yahan 'but to obey' sahi hoga. Note:- 'but' jab conjunction hota hai toh iska matlab 'lekin' hota hai.

questions.question: He is not such a clever boy that you are.
questions.solution: use 'as' instead of 'that'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'that' ki jagah 'as' aayega kyunki 'such-as' ka use 'Jo, jaisa, jisne, jisko' waale meaning ke liye use hota hai. Aur 'such-that' ka use 'ki' waale meaning ke liye hota hai. yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'wo waisa clever boy nahi hai jaise tum ho', toh meaning ke accoding 'jaisa' waale meaning ke liye 'such' ke sath 'as' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: We have not only come /to meet you/ but also to congratulate/ you on your victory.
questions.solution: Use 'not only' after 'come'. Explanation:- 'not only' ki position 'come' ke baad hogi, kyunki 'either…or, neither…nor, not only…but also, both…..and' yeh aise co-relative conjunctions hain jo same rank ke words ko join karti hain. 'not only' ke baad 'come' verb likhi hai aur 'but also' ke baad 'to congratulate' infinitive likha, toh 'but also' ko change nahi kar payenge kyunki iske pass verb nahi hai, isliye 'not only' ko 'come' verb ke baad likh denge, jiske 'not only' 'to meet' infinitive se aur 'but also' 'to congratulate' infinitive se jude jayege, isliye yahan 'come not only' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Inspite Smita had taken part in many television serials earlier, this was the first time she was going to host a live show.
questions.solution: use 'although/though' instead of 'inspite'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'inspite' ki jagah 'although/though' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab chahiye 'haalanki wo bahut TV serial mein part le chuki, yeh pehli baar hoga ki wo live show ko host karegi', toh 'haalanki' waale meaning ek liye 'inspite' ka nahi 'although' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Our nation can make significant growth but if we all work collectively.
questions.solution: Use 'only if ' instead of 'but if'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'but if' ki jagah 'only if' aayega kyunki 'but' ka use contradiction dikhaane ke liye hota hai, lekin sentence mein contradiction nahi balki agle clause ki baat ko jodne ke liye hai. Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'humara nation tabhi acchi growth kar sakta hai sirf agar hum sab mil kar kaam karein.' Toh sahi meaning ke liye 'only if' ka use sahi hoga. waise bhi 2 clause ko jodne ke liye 'but' aur 'if' do conjunction ka use sath mein galat hai, aur 'only if' ek conditional phrase hai, isliye iska use yahan sahi hoga

questions.question: We had to decline several orders in case that the production was held up due to labour strike.
questions.solution: use 'because' instead of 'in case that'. Explanation:-sentence mein 'in case that' ki jagah 'because' aayega kyunki sentence mein reason batana hai, jiske liye reason batane waali conjunction ka use hoga. sentence ka matlab 'hume bahut order decline karne pade kyunki labour strike ki wazah se production band tha', isliye meaning ke according 'because' ka use sahi hoga. 'in case that' ka use future possibility ke liye use hota hai.

questions.question: Cyclone Idai killed at least 157 people in Zimbabwe and Mozambique although it tore across Southern Africa.
questions.solution: use 'as/when' instead of 'although'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'although' ki jagah 'as/when' ka use hoga kyunki 'although' ka use contradiction dikhaane ke liye hota hai, lekin sentence mein aage reason batana hai sentence ka matlab hai 'cyclone Idai ne 157 log maare jab yeh southern Africa mein tabaahi macha raha tha', toh 'jab' waale meaning ke liye yahan 'as/when' conjunction ka use sahi hoga. Note:- 'as' ka ek meaning 'jab' wala bhi hota hai.

questions.question: She got two quick promotions in order that she has good communication skills.
questions.solution: use 'because' instead of 'in order that'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'in order that' ki jagah 'because' aayega kyunki 'in order that' ka matlab 'taaki' hota hai aur 'because' ka matlab 'kyunki' hota hai. Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'usko do quick promotion mile kyunki uske paas acchi communication skills hai'. Toh sahi meaning ke according 'because' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: Either you and he will have to pay for this damage.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'either' ke sath 'or' ka pair hota hai aur yeh correlative conjunction hoti hai , isliye option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: While he saw the bear, he ran to the nearest tree, dropped his gun and climbed to a safe place.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option C galat hai kyunki 'no sooner' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai. D option bhi galat hoga kyunki 'hardly' ke sath 'when' ka pair hota hai. Sentence ka matlab hai 'jab unse bear ko dekha, toh apne pass waale tree ki taraf bhaag gaya', toh B option bhi galat hai kyunki 'while' duration ko refer karta hai aur yahan ek fix point of time ki baat karni hai. Isliye A option 'when he saw the bear' sahi hoga

questions.question: The secretary to my boss is very efficient as he not only gives him the required information and also handles correspondence independently.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'not only' ke sath 'but also' ka pair hota hai joki correlative conjunction hoti hai, aur yeh same rank ke words ko connect karte hai, isliye B option sahi hai.

questions.question: Last before year, Shirley got very good grades.
questions.solution: Explanation:- A and D option grammatically sahi structure nahi hai. B option tab lagta agar yahan yeh meaning diya hota ki 'Last year se pehle Shirley ke kaffi acche marks aate the', matlab 'last year se pehle jitne bhi year the', tab yeh baat habitual action ho jaati, aur past ke habitual action ke liye 'used to' model ka use hota. C option 'the year before last' ka matlab hai 'pichle year se 1 year pichewala year'. Toh yeh meaning wise and grammatically option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: The soldiers had no choice to report the loss to their commander.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'soldiers ke paas commander ko report karne ke sivay koi choice nahi thi..', toh 'no choice but to' phrase hota hai jiska matlab 'ek hee option hona, aur koi choice naa hona' hota hai, jisme 'but' preposition ka kaam kar raha hai aur iska matlab 'ke sivaay' hota hai, isliye 'no choice but to' option D sahi hoga. Note:- 'but' jab conjunction hota hai toh iska matlab 'lekin' hota hai.

questions.question: Keep the dog tied indoors; however, it may bite some stranger.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yeh meaning pe based error hai. 'however' ka matlab 'halaanki', 'yet' ka matlab 'fir bhi', 'still' ka matlab 'fir bhi', 'else' ka maltab 'warna'. Sentence ka matlab hai 'dog ko andar rakho warna yeh kisi anjaan ko kaat lega'. Toh sahi meaning ke according 'else' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: She is as good if not better than her sister.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan 'she' ka 'her sister' se comparison hai. yeh sentence ka complete structure aisa hai 'She is as good as her sister is if she is not better than her sister is'. yahan same 2 logon ka 2 baar comparison hua hai isliye subject and verbs understood hogye hain, lekin simile (conj) ka poora structure hi likha jaayega. isliye B option 'as good as' sahi hai.

questions.question: Keep him at arm's length lest you may not repent in the long run.
questions.solution: Explanation:- option D sahi hoga kyunki 'lest' ke sath 'should' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: He is interested neither in business or on the job.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'neither' ke sath 'nor' ka pair hota hai aur yeh ek correlative conjunction hoti hai jo 'same rank' ke words ko connect karti hai, isliye 'nor in a job' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: You can have a comfortable journey only then you are getting your seats reserved in advance.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'sirf agar tum apni ticket advance mein reserve karao', toh 'sirf agar' waale meaning ke liye 'only if' ka use hoga joki conjunction ki tarah kaam karega, isliye D option 'only if you get' sahi hoga. baaki 'only then', 'only when' yeh adverbial phrase hota hai, yeh conjunction ka kaam nahi karte.

questions.question: Turn left outside the library door and walk down the corridor then you came to the main staircase.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai 'corridor mein chalte raho jab tak tum main staircase tak naa pahunch jao', toh 'jab tak nahi' waale meaning ke liye 'until' ka use hoga, aur 'turn' aur 'walk' se pata chal raha ki present tense ki baat karni hai, isliye 'until' aur present tense 'come' wala 'until you come to' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: He's not so friendly like she is.
questions.solution: Explanation:- sentence mein negative comparison karna hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'wo utna friendly nahi hai jitni tum ho. Toh 'as….as' ka use 'positive aur negative' comparison ke liye hota hai, lekin 'so….as' ke use sirf negative comparison ke liye hota hai. Options mein 'as…..as' wala option nahi hai, isliye 'so friendly as' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: In spite of my niece's dog Casper is very mischievous, he is lovable.
questions.solution: Explanation:- sentence ka matlab hai 'uski niece ka dog 'Casper' matlab 'dog' pe possession banana hai, jiske liye 'my neice' pe apostrophe 's' ka use hoga, isliye option A aur D galat honge hai. B option bhi galat hai kyunki 'inspite of' ek preposition hoti hai aur yahan 2 clauses ko join karne ke liye 'conjunction' chahiye. Option C se matlab hoga 'halaanki meri niece ka dog sharaarti hai, sab usse pyar karte hai' isliye meaning and grammar ke according C option 'Although my neice's ' sahi hai.

questions.question: Such was his performance that the audience gave a standing ovation.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'Aisi thi uski performance ki audience ne standing ovation di', toh 'ki' waale meaning ke liye 'such' ke sath 'that' ka use hota hai, sentence mein aage 'that' likha hai, isliye 'such was' 'no substitution required' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Unless you carry a Covid-19 negative report, you can travel by air.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'provided' or 'provided that' yeh conjunction hoti hai jiska meaning 'basharte, agar(if)' hota hai. yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'Agar apke paas covid ki negative report hai to aap by air travel kar sakte hain' iss meaning liye B option 'provided' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Unless we are not sure of our goals, we cannot achieve them.
options: Except if we are not sure
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'unless' ka matlab 'agar nahi' hota hai, aur 'unless' jiss clause ke sath lagta hai uss clause mein 'not' ka use nahi hota kyunki 'unless' se wo 'not' understood ho jata hai, yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'agar hum apne goals ko leke sure nahi hai toh hum unhe achieve nahi kar sakte', toh meaning ke according 'unless' ka use sahi hai, isliye 'unless we are sure' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Hurry up, in case you will be late for your school.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yeh meaning based error hai. yahan meaning yeh dena ki 'jaldi karo warna tum school ke liye late ho jayoge', toh 'warna' waale meaning ke liye A option 'otherwise' sahi hoga

questions.question: Cakes are Jaya's favourite snack, even samosas is Aparna's preferred choice.
questions.solution: Explanation:- sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye conjunction chahiye, lekin 'even' toh adverb hota hai, isliye option C galat hoga. option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'either' ke sath 'or' ka pair hota hai. Sentence mein 'samosas' subject plural hai, isliye plural verb ayegi aur sentence ka matlab chahiye 'cake Jaya ka favourite food hai, jabki Aparna samosa prefer karti hai', toh plural verb aur 'jabki' waale meaning ke liye 'while samosas are' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: No sooner I get the message; I shall pass it on to you.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'No sooner' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai aur 'hardly' ke sath 'when' ka joki dono option mein nahi hai isliye C and D options galat hain. yahan meaning dena hai ki 'jaise hi muje message milega, waise he tumhe pass kar dunga', toh 'jaise he' waale meaning ke liye 'as soon as' option A sahi hoga. baaki 'although' ka matlab 'halaanki' hota hai jo contradiction dikhaane ke kaam aata hai.

questions.question: Just when I sit down, than the doorbell rang.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'No sooner' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai joki ek correlative conjunction hai, 'no sooner' ke sath inversion bhi follow hota hai, toh meaning ke according option A 'No sooner did I' sahi hoga

questions.question: She had grown too thin which she looked like Scarecrow.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'too' ke sath infinitive ka pair hota hai, isliye option B aur D galat honge. Option A bhi galat hoga kyunki 'that' ke sath 'such' yaa 'so' ka pair banta hai. Sentence ka matlab chahiye 'wo itni patli ho gayi thi ki wo scarecrow ki tarah dikhne lagi', toh meaning ke according 'so thin that' wala option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: I cannot help you if you tell me your problem.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'mai tumhari help nahi kar sakta agar tum mujhe apni problem nahi bataoge', 'unless' ka matlab 'agar nahi' hota hai aur 'until/unless' jiss clause ke sath lagta hai usme 'not' ka use galat hota hai. isliye 'unless you tell me' wala D option sahi hoga.

questions.question: Unless someone makes a complaint, they will not clear the garbage from the street.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'Without, Despite, Except' yeh sab prepositions hai, lekin sentence mein 2 clauses ko join karne ke liye conjunction ka use karte hai. isliye meaning and grammar ke according question mein diya 'unless.....' sahi hoga .

questions.question: Because she didn't love him, she had to marry him.
questions.solution: Explanation:- option A aur C galat honge kyunki 'because' aur 'since' conjunction ka use reason bataane ke liye hota, lekin sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai. Option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'despite' preposition hoti hai, jabki humhe yahan conjunction chahiye do clause ke liye. Option B sahi hoga jisse matlab hoga 'halaanki wo usse pyar nahi karti thi, usse shadi karni padi', toh meaning ke according 'altough' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The train was delayed in order to an accident.
questions.solution: Explanation:- sentence mein 'train was' ek hee clause hai, toh yahan conjunction ki jarurat nahi hai isliye A and C options galat hain. B option bhi galat hai kyunki 'In order + to + verb' sahi structure hota hai. isliye meaning aur grammar ke according D option sahi hai. Note:- 'owing to' ka meaning 'because of' hota hai. Joki prepositional phrase hota hai.

questions.question: She was smiling but looking pleased about something.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan koi contradiction nhi dikhana hai, isliye option A aur C galat honge. Option B bhi galat hoga kyunki 'so' ka matlab 'isliye' hota hai, joki meaning ke according galat hai. Sentence ka matlab chahiye 'wo smile kar rahi thi aur khush thi kisi cheez ko leke' isliye meaning ke according yahan D option 'and looked' sahi hai.

questions.question: She was so tall to reach the top shelf.
questions.solution: Explanation:- sentence mein 'reach' verb hai lekin subject nahi hai matlab second clause nahi banega, isliye option B 'so tall that' galat hoga kyunki yeh clauses ko jodne ke liye kaam aata hai, option A bhi galat hoga kyunki 'so' ke sath 'to' ka use galat hai, option C bhi galat hoga kyunki 'too' ke sath infinitive ka pair banta hai. Option D 'tall enough to' sahi hoga jisse matlab hoga 'wo upper shelf tak pahuchne ke liye paryapt lambi thi', aur 'to reach' se infinitive bhi banega, jo meaning wise aur grammar wise sahi hoga, toh option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: But for their valour, they would have been defeated.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'unki bahaduri ke bina wo haar gaye hote', toh 'but for' ek phrase hota hai jiska matlab 'ke bina (without)' hota hai, isliye question mein diya structure sahi hai.

questions.question: So much as you behave like this, the decision of the management against you cannot be revoked.
questions.solution: Explanation:- option A aur C galat honge kyunki 'as' ke sath 'to' ka structure grammatically galat hai. Option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'much' ka use quantity ka refer karne ke liye hota hai. yahan meaning yeh dena hai ki 'jab tak tum aise hi behave karoge.....', iss meaning ke liye B option 'as long as' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Hardly had he sit on the chair than it broke.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'hardly' ke sath 'when' ka pair hota hai joki correlative conjunction hoti hai. aur 'had' ke baad v3 ka use hoga isliye B option 'sat on the chair when' sahi hai.

questions.question: A woman cannot understand (a)/ how difficult it is to take care of a newborn baby (b)/ unless she doesn't experience the sleepless nights herself (c)/ for several weeks. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'doesn't experience' with 'experiences'. Explanation:- 'unless' ka matlab hota hai 'jab tak nahi' jisme 'not' pehle se understood hota hai aur yeh conjunction jis clause mein aati hai, uss clause mein negative ka use nahi karte, isliye yahan 'doesn't' nahi aayega, kyunki 'she' singular hai, isliye yahan singular verb 'experiences' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Both government policies as well as individual (a)/responsibility are necessary to reduce pollution (b)/ and protect natural resources for future generations. (c)No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'as well as' with 'and'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as well as' ki jagah 'and' aayega kyunki 'both' ke sath 'and' ka pair hota hai aur yeh co-relative conjunction hai, isliye yahan 'both government policies and individual' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: A wise investor knows that (a)/ he has no other option (b)/ but to diversify his investments across multiple sectors (c)/ to protect himself from unexpected financial crises. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'but' with 'than'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'but' ki jagah 'than' aayega kyunki 'other' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai aur yeh ek co-relative conjunction hai, isliye yahan 'no other option than' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: As soon as the heavy rain (a)/ started pouring on the crowded street (b)/ then people rushed to take shelter in nearby shops. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'then'. Explanation:- Sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek conjunction ki jarurat hai aur wo conjunction 'as soon as' aa chuki hai, isliye yahan 'then' remove hoga. aur waise bhi 'as soon as' ka use do action sath mein ho rahe hai yeh dikhane ke liye use karte hai jabki 'then' ka use ek action ke baad dusra action batane ke liye use hota hai, aur dono conjunction ka use sath mein contradictory ho jaayega.

questions.question: The children were playing happily in the backyard (a)/ during their mothers were preparing (b)/lunch for them in the kitchen. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'during' with 'while'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'during' ki jagah 'while' aayega kyunki 'during' preposition hoti hai aur sentence mein do clauses ko jodne ke liye conjunction ki jarurat hai, kyunki sentence mein continuous tense hai isliye yahan 'while' conjunction ko prefer karenge. Sentence ka matlab hoga 'bacche khel rahe hai jabki unki mother khaana bana rahi thi', isliye yahan 'while' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She asked me that why (a)/ I had suddenly moved to a new city (b)/ without informing anyone in my neighbourhood. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'that'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'that' conjunction nahi ayegi kyunki sentence ke indirect speech mein likhe hone ke kaaran 'if, how, why, where, when' yeh word khud conjunction ki tarah kaam karne lagte hai, kyunki sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek conjunction ki jarurat hai, aur 'asked' verb ke according 'why' se meaning sahi aayega, isliye yahan 'that' conjunction ka prayog nahi hoga.

questions.question: No sooner did (a)/ she send her job application (b)/ then she received a reply inviting her for an interview (c)/ which surprised her because she wasn't expecting such a quick response. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'then' with 'than'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'then' ki jagah 'than' aayega kyunki 'no sooner…..than' ek co-relative conjunction hoti hai, isliye yahan 'than' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The new technology is as efficient, if not (a)/ more than most (b)/ systems currently used in government offices (c)/ for long-term data storage. (d)
questions.solution: add 'as' after 'as efficient'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as efficient' ke baad 'as' aayega kyunki iss se simile ka structure complete hoga, isliye yahan 'as efficient as' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Maria finished the marathon (a)/ with a bright smile on her face (b)/ even she was exhausted after running for hours. (c)/ No error(d)
questions.solution: replace 'even' with 'although/though/even though'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'even' nahi aayega kyunki 'even' ek adverb hoti hai, lekin sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye conjunction ki jarurat hai, aur sentence mein contradiction bhi dikhaana ki 'usne marathon finish kari haalanki wo exhaust ho chuki thi', isliye yahan contradiction dikhaane ke liye 'altough, though, even though' conjunction ka use sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: The environmental campaign (a)/ raised not only awareness about plastic pollution (b)/ but also encouraged people to adopt sustainable habits (c)/ in their daily lifestyle. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'raised not only' with 'not only raised'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'raised' 'not only' ke baad aayega kyunki 'not only…...but also' co-relative conjunction hoti hai jo same rank ke word ko connect karti hai, kyunki 'but also' ke baad verb likhi hai, waise he 'not only' ke baad bhi verb aayegi, isliye 'raised' ki position 'not only' ke baad karni padegi.

questions.question: Hardly had the students begun solving (a)/ the questions than the invigilator announced (b)/ an important instruction (c)/ about the question paper. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'than' with 'when'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'than' ki jagah 'when' aayega kyunki 'hardly/scarcely' ke sath 'when' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: The teacher said to the students (a)/ "Complete your homework on time, lest you (b)/ will face difficulty in understanding tomorrow's lesson." (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'will' with 'should'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'will' ki jagah 'should' aayega kyunki 'lest' ke sath 'should' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: He saves a portion of his income every month (a)/ that he can build a secure future (b)/ for his family and avoid financial stress (c)/ during emergencies. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'that' with 'so that'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'that' ki jagah 'so that' aayega kyunki sentence mein matlab dena hai 'wo apni income ka portion save karta hai taaki apni family ke liye future secure kar sake', 'that' ka matlab hota hai 'ki' aur 'so that' ka matlab hota hai 'taaki', toh 'taaki' waale meaning ke liye 'so that' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: It is incorrect to assume that artificial intelligence systems can behave same like the human brain in all situations.
options: It is incorrect to assume that
questions.solution: replace 'same like' with 'same as'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'like' ki jagah 'as' aayega kyunki 'same like' jaisa koi term nahi hota, isliye 'same as' ka use sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: As she had prepared well for the debate competition, she forgot her lines on stage.
options: she forgot her lines on stage
questions.solution: replace 'as' with 'although'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as' ki jagah 'although' aayega kyunki 'as' ka matlab 'kyunki' hota hai, lekin sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai 'halanki usse acche se prepare kiya tha, wo apni line bhool gayi', toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'although' conjunction sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: At the end of the long trek we were exhausted and delighted that we had finally reached the summit.
options: At the end of the long trek
that we had finally reached the summit
questions.solution: replace 'and' with 'but'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'and' ki jagah 'but' aayega kyunki 'and' conjunction se same degree adjective judenge, yaa toh positive yaa negative. 'exhausted' aur 'delighted' dono contradiction show kar rahe hai, isliye contradiction dikhaane waali conjunction 'but' ka use sabse sahi hoga. jisse matlab hoga 'wo thak gaye the lekin khush the'.

questions.question: Researchers have discovered that certain plants (a)/ can defend themselves against harmful insects (b)/ by releasing natural chemicals as pheromones, essential oils, and defensive enzymes. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'as' with 'such as/like'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as' ki jagah 'such as, like' aayega kyunki sentence mein natural chemical ke example dene hai jiske liye 'such as' yaa 'like' preposition ka use karte hai, 'such as' jab sath likha hota hai toh yeh preposition ka kaam karta hai, isliye yahan 'such as', 'like' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: You will not succeed in this exam as you study regularly with complete focus.
options: You will not succeed in this exam
questions.solution: replace 'as' with 'unless'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as' ki jagah 'unless' aayega kyunki 'as' se meaning galat aa raha hai. sentence mein meaning chahiye 'tum succeed nahi ho payoge agar tum regularly padhai nahi karoge', toh sentence mein 'agar nahi' waale meaning ke liye 'unless' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Smart home devices have made daily life far more convenient and automated, so they also pose serious privacy concerns for users around the world.
options: Smart home devices have made daily life
so they also pose serious privacy concerns
questions.solution: replace 'so' with 'but'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'so' ki jagah 'but' aayega kyunki 'so' ka use aage result bataane ke liye use hota hai, lekin sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai matlab 'device acche hai lekin users ko privacy concerns bhi hai', isliye yahan contradiction dikhaane waali conjunction 'but'(lekin) sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The earthquake caused massive destruction although it struck the city during the early hours of the morning.
options: the city during the early hours of the morning
questions.solution: replace 'although' with 'when'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'although' ki jagah 'when' ka use hoga kyunki 'although' contradiction ke liye use karte hai, lekin sentence mein 'jab' wala meaning chahiye matlab 'earthquake ne destruction machaya jab usne city ko struck kiya', toh 'jab' waale meaning ke liye 'when' conjunction sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: If this cadet can run ten miles with ease (a)/ and complete high-altitude drills without resting, (b)/ his partner struggles to finish even half the course (c)/ and gasps for breath after every steep climb. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'if' with 'while'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'if' ki jagah 'while' aayega kyunki sentence mein 'agar' wala meaning nahi chahiye, sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai ki 'ek cadet ten miles aaram se chal leta, jabki dusra half bhi muskil se chal pata hai', toh contradiction dikhaane ke liye 'while' conjunction sabse sahi answer hoga. Note:- 'although' bhi use kar sakte lekin sentence mein reason, result jaisa meaning nahi hai, isliye 'while' use kiya.

questions.question: Such intelligence officers who monitor dark-web activities (a)/ to prevent cyber-attacks and digital frauds (b)/ often work anonymously (c)/ and handle extremely sensitive information. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'who' with 'as'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'who' ki jagah 'as' aayega kyunki 'such……as' ka use 'jo, jaise, jisne' waale meaning ke liye karte hai aur 'as' relative pronoun ka bhi work karta hai, jisse matlab hoga 'aise officer jo monitor karte hai', aur 'as' 'monitor' verb ke liye subject(pronoun) ka bhi kaam kar raha hai, isliye meaning ke according 'as' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The witness was (a)/ too nervous (b)/ for speak the truth in the courtroom (c)/ after receiving threats from the accused gang members. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'for speak' with 'to speak'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'for' ki jagah 'to' aayega kyunki 'too' ke sath infinitive 'to+v1' ka pair hota hai jo negative comparison karta hai, isliye yahan 'to speak' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: In today's world, you cannot achieve financial stability (a)/ although you save and invest a decent amount every month (b)/ because steady planning and disciplined saving (c)/ are required to secure your future. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'although' with 'unless'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'although' ki jagah 'unless' aayega kyunki sentence mein contradiction nahi dikhaane, balki yeh kehna hai 'tum financial stability nahi achieve kar payoge agar tum decent amount save nahi karoge', toh 'agar nahi' waale meaning ke liye 'unless' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: A successful career can give you financial security, (a)/ global exposure, and respect in society, as it also (b)/ demands time, sacrifices, and long years of consistency (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'as it' with 'but it'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as' ki jagah 'but' aayega kyunki 'as' ka matlab 'kyunki' hai, lekin sentence mein contradiction dikhaana hai. matlab hoga ki 'ek successful career tumhe yeh sab dila sakta hai, lekin yeh time, sacrifice aur consistency ki demand bhi karta hai', toh 'lekin' waale meaning ke 'but' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She is neither interested in casual relationships (a)/ or ready for marriage right now (b)/ as she wants to focus on her career (c)/ and explore life independently. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'or' with 'nor'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'or' ki jagah 'nor' aayega kyunki 'neither' ke sath 'nor' ka pair hota hai, jo ki ek co-relative conjunction hai, isliye yahan 'nor' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The students asked the administrator (a)/ that if the university portal would crash again like last year (b)/ because the server was already running slow. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'that'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'that' conjunction nahi ayegi kyunki sentence ke indirect speech mein likhe hone ke kaaran 'if, how, why, where, when' yeh word khud conjunction ki tarah kaam karne lagte hai, kyunki sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek conjunction ki jarurat hai, aur 'asked' verb ke according 'if' se meaning sahi aayega, isliye yahan 'that' conjunction ka prayog nahi hoga.

questions.question: Not only the employees reported repeated system crashes (a)/ and slow network issues, (b)/ but they also complained about frequent data loss (c)/ during the peak working hours. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'the employees reported' with 'did the employees report'. Explanation:- 'not only' ka 'but also' ka pair hota hai aur iske sath inversion ka structure bhi follow hota hai, isliye 'not only did the employees report' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The reason for thousands of aspirants gathering (a)/ outside the commission office last week (b)/ was because the exam results (c)/ were delayed without any official notification. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'because' with 'that'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'because' ki jagah 'that' aayega kyunki 'reason' ke sath 'because' superfluous ki category mein aata hai, kyunki yeh dono 'kaaran' batane ke liye use hote hai. toh sentence mein 'kii' waale matlab ke liye 'that' conjunction ka use karenge, jisse matlab hoga ki 'reason yeh tha ki exam delay ho gaya', isliye yahan 'that' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: When the cyclist noticed a car speeding recklessly towards the crossing (a)/ he waved his hands repeatedly (b)/ so that to alert the pedestrians (c)/ standing near the zebra crossing. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'so that' with 'so as'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'so that' ki jagah 'so as' aayega kyunki 'so that' ke baad clause likha jaata hai aur 'so as' ke baad infinitive, kyunki sentence mein 'to alert' infinitive likha hai, isliye yahan 'so as' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: This social media platform will implement strict verification rules (a)/ to reduce misinformation and fake profiles (b)/ if the influencers like them or not. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'if' with 'whether'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'if' ki jagah 'whether' aayega kyunki 'whether' ke sath 'or' ka pair hota hai, isliye yahan 'whether' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The storm across the coastal districts (a)/ was such a violent one (b)/ but fishermen couldn't sail their boats (c)/ for two consecutive days. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'but' with 'that'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'but' ki jagah 'that' aayega kyunki 'such' ke sath 'as', 'that' ka pair hota hai. 'kii' waale meaning ke liye 'such…..that' aur 'jo, jaise, jisne' waale meaning ke liye 'such….as'. sentence ka matlab hai 'storm itna violent tha ki fishermen boat sail nahi kar paaye', toh 'kii' wala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'such' ke sath 'that' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The express train was delayed for several hours (a)/ at the central station (b)/ because the dense fog covering the tracks (c)/ early in the morning. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'because' with 'because of'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'because' ki jagah 'because of' aayega kyunki 'because' conjunction hai jo do clause ko jodne ka kaam karti hai, lekin 'the dense fog…….morning' yeh clause nahi hai kyunki isme verb nahi hai, isliye conjunction ko hata ke 'because of' preposition ka use sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: You are so late (a)/ to start preparing for this year's civil services exam (b)/ so you should prepare for the next year's exam (c)/ for better results. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'so' with 'too'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'so' ki jagah 'too' aayega kyunki sentence mein negative meaning convey karna hai 'iss saal preparation start karne ke liye pehle se hee late ho', aur aage 'to start' infinitive bhi likha hai aur negative meaning bhi chahiye, isliye 'so' ki jagah 'too' sahi hoga, isliye 'too late to start' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: As such you ever receive suspicious messages (a)/ on social media asking for your personal details (b)/ report and block the sender (c)/ without replying. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'as such' with 'if'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'as such' ki jagah 'if' aayega kyunki 'as such' ka 'theek thaak, aisa koi' matlab hota hai, lekin sentence ka matlab 'agar tumhare pass aise koi message aaye jo tumhari personal detail maange toh report or block kar dena', sentence mein 'agar' waala meaning chahiye, isliye yahan 'if' conjunction sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Always wear a helmet while riding a two-wheeler (a)/ but you might face a hefty fine or (b)/ serious injury if an accident happens. (c) No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'but' with 'otherwise/or/else'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'but' ki jagah 'otherwise' aayega kyunki 'but' ka matlab 'lekin' hota hai, lekin sentence ka matlab hai 'humesha two-weeler chalate samay helmet peheno warna tumhe hefty fine dena pad sakta hai', toh 'warna' waale meaning ke liye 'otherwise/or/else' ka use hota hai, sabse common 'otherwise' use hota hai, isliye yahan 'otherwise' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: I was amazed to know that if Riya (a)/ had designed a working model (b)/ of a solar-powered water purifier (c)/ on her own. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'if'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'if' nahi aayega kyunki 'if' ka matlab 'kya' hai, lekin sentence mein kehna hai 'mein yeh jaan ke amaze tha ki Riya ne model design kiya hai', toh sentence mein 'kii' wala meaning chahiye jo ki 'that' se aayega aur do clause ko jodne ke liye ek hee conjunction ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'if' ka prayog nahi hoga.

questions.question: Students find it much easier (a)/ to watch recorded lectures (b)/ then to attend a live class with full concentration. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'then' with 'than'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'then' ki jagah 'than' aayega kyunki 'then' adverb hota hai, aur 'easier' comparative degree lagi jiske sath 'than' conjunction ka use hota hai, isliye yahan 'than' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: She missed her practical examination (a)/ due to she was suffering from (b)/ various medical issues (c)/ No error. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'due to' with 'because'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'due to' ki jagah 'because' aayega kyunki 'due to/owing to' yeh preposition hoti hai aur sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye conjunction ki jarurat hai, aur 'kyunki' wala meaning chahiye , isliye 'because' conjunction sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The doctors had no choice when to perform (a)/ an emergency surgery on the accident victim, (b)/ as delaying the procedure could have resulted (c)/ in severe internal bleeding and permanent organ damage. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'when' with 'but'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'when' ki jagah 'but' aayega kyunki 'no choice' ke sath 'but' fixed conjunction aati hai, isliye yahan 'but' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Our rural healthcare system can improve (a)/ but if we invest more in medical infrastructure (b)/ and train local doctors properly. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'but if' with 'only if'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'but if' ki jagah 'only if' aayega kyunki 'but if' se 'lekin agar' wala meaning aayega, aur 'but' contradiction show karta hai. lekin sentence ka matlab hai 'healthcare system improve ho sakta hai sirf agar hum jyada invest kare medical infrastructure mein', toh 'sirf agar' waale chahiye, isliye yahan 'only if' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Many army units have been deployed (a)/ in Delhi and other major cities (b)/ in order that intelligence agencies have noticed some (c)/ suspicious activities in border areas. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'in order that' with 'because'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'in order that' ki jagah 'because' aayega kyunki 'in order that' ka matlab 'taaki' hota hai, lekin sentence mein 'jo army deploy kari gayi' uska reason batana hai, 'kyunki' wala meaning dena hai, isliye yahan reason batane waali conjunction 'because' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The new government policy (a) / neither aims to reduce unemployment (b) / nor improve the quality of education (c) / across rural areas effectively. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'neither aims' with 'aims neither'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'neither' 'aims' ke baad aayega kyunki 'neither…..nor' co-relative conjunction hoti hai jo same type ke words ko connect karti hai, kyunki 'nor' ke sath 'improve' infinitive hai bina 'to' ke, aur 'nor' ke paas koi verb nahi hai, isliye 'neither' bhi verb ke sath nahi balki 'to reduce' infinitive ke sath lagega, isliye 'aims neither to reduce' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Either this high-performance electric car, which offers rapid acceleration and advanced self-driving features, and the hybrid SUV will be selected for the road-trip across the mountains.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option A sahi hoga kyunki 'either' ke sath 'or' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: While he heard the explosion, he immediately rushed outside, called the emergency services, and tried his best to help the injured people who were screaming for assistance.
options: No sooner did he hear the explosion
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'while he heard the explosion' galat hoga kyunki 'while' duration ke sath aata hai aur 'explosion' se pata chal raha ki isme koi duration nahi hai, isliye option B galat hoga. option A bhi galat hoga kyunki 'hardly' ke sath inversion lagta hai. option C bhi nahi hoga kyunki 'no sooner' ke sath 'than' ka pair hota hai. option D sahi hoga jisse matlab hoga 'jab usne explosion suna, wo turant hee bahar chal gaya'.

questions.question: After the sudden breakdown of their car in the middle of the highway, the family had no choice to wait patiently for the towing service to arrive.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option C sahi hoga kyunki 'no choice' ke sath 'but' ka pair hota hai.

questions.question: Ensure that your car has sufficient fuel, proper tyre pressure, and all essential tools before starting this long highway journey however you may get stranded in an isolated area with no help nearby.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein 'however' ki jagah 'otherwise' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hai 'car mein saari cheezein check kar lena warna tum waha akele padh jayoge', sentence mein 'warna' wala meaning chahiye, jiske liye 'otherwise' option B sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: This phone is not as durable like the previous model, which could easily withstand rough use and still work smoothly for years.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein simile waali baat karni hai aur simile 'as…..as', 'so…..as' se banti hai. 'as….as' waali simile positive ke liye aur 'so….as' waali positive aur negative dono ke liye aati hai. options mein dono option available hai, isliye negative ke according 'so durable as' ko prefer karenge, isliye option A sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: In spite of my friend's little puppy gets excited and chews everything, everyone adores him because he's so playful.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein 'in spite of' ki jagah 'although' aayega kyunki 'in spite of' preposition hoti hai aur sentence mein teen clauses ko jodne ke liye do conjunction ki jarurat hai, ek conjunction 'because' likhi aur dusri chahiye, sentence ka matlab hai 'halanki wo puppy excited ho jata hai, sab chaba leta hai, usse sab log pasand karte kyunki wo playful' hai, toh 'halanki' waale meaning ke liye 'although' option B sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Such was the intensity of the storm that the entire coastal town had to be evacuated urgently to ensure everyone's safety.
questions.solution: 'No substitution required'

questions.question: Unless you have balance in your metro smart card, you will face no problem in entering the station.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein 'unless' ki jagah 'provided' aayega kyunki 'unless' ka matlab 'agar nahi' jisse meaning galat aa raha hai, sentence ka matlab 'agar tumhare metro card mein balance hai toh tumhe station mein koi problem nahi ayegi', 'agar' waale meaning chahiye lekin 'if' option mein nahi hai toh option mein 'if' jaisa meaning dene wala 'provided' hai jiska matlab 'basharte' hota, isliye option C sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Pasta is Rohan's favourite food, even burgers is Priya's favourite.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'pasta Rohan ka favourite food hai, jabki burger Priya ka favourite hai', toh contradiction dikhana aur 'jabki' waale meaning chahiye, jiske liye 'while' sahi hoga, isliye option B 'while burgers are' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: No sooner you complete the online application; you will receive a confirmation email along with your registration ID.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option C aur D galat honge kyunki 'no sooner' aur 'hardly' ke sath inversion ka structure follow hota hai aur 'no sooner' ke sath 'than', 'hardly' ke sath 'when' follow hota. Sentence ka matlab hai 'jaise he online app complete karoge, tumhe confirmation email aayega', toh dono kaam sath mein hona batana hai, jiske liye 'as soon as' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Just when we locked the main door and stepped outside for our evening walk, than it started raining heavily.
options: No sooner did we lock the main door and step outside
Hardly when we locked the main door
As soon as we locked the main door
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option A sahi hoga kyunki sentence mein 'than' se pata chal raha ki 'no sooner' aayega aur 'no sooner' ke sath inversion ka structure bhi follow hota hai, isliye option A sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: Unless residents submit a written request to the municipality, they will not install new streetlights in the neighbourhood.
options: Without residents submit a written request
Despite residents submit a written request
Except residents submit a written request
questions.solution: No substitution required

questions.question: She spoke politely but behaving confidently during the meeting, which impressed everyone present in the conference room.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein 'politely' aur 'confidently' dono positive baatein hai, isliye inhe 'and' conjunction ke sath likhenge, agar dono contradiction baatein hoti toh 'but' aata. Isliye diye gaye options mein se option C 'and behaved' sabse sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The ladder was so long to reach the roof of the old farmhouse when the workers needed to repair the chimney.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option A galat hoga kyunki 'too…ke sath….to' ka pair hota hai. option D bhi galat hoga kyunki 'so ke sath 'that' ka pair hota hai. option C bhi galat hoga kyunki 'that' ke baad clause likhte hai, lekin sentence mein clause nahi hai. 'long enough to' sahi hoga jisse matlab hoga 'ladder itni paryapt lambi thi farmhouse ki roof tak pahuch gayi', isliye option B 'long enough to' sabse sahi answer hoga

questions.question: But for his timely medical advice, the patient would have suffered from severe complications and might not have recovered so quickly.
options: Except with his timely medical advice
Because of his timely medical advice
But about his timely medical advice
questions.solution: No improvement. Explanation:- 'but for' ka maltab 'without' hota hai, jisse sentence ka matlab hoga ki 'bina timely medical advice ke, patient seriously suffer karta'.

questions.question: So much as you keep helping me in my projects, I will not tell your secret to our parents.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option C sahi hoga kyunki sentence ka matlab chahiye 'jab tak tum meri project mein help karte rahoge, mein yeh secret parents ko kabhi nahi batayunga', toh 'jab tak ki' waale meaning ke liye 'as long as' ka use hota hai.

questions.question: Hardly had she opened the classroom window than a strong gust of wind blew inside and scattered all the papers across the desks.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Option B sahi hoga kyunki 'hardly' ke sath 'when' ka pair aur inversion follow hota hai. aur 'had' ke baad verb ki 3rd form aati hai. isliye option B sabse sahi answer hoga.
